title: 7 · Accumulation and import (Parts 16-20)
description: Host calls and accumulation, the statistics a block keeps, block import (its plan, the whole state, real blocks), and sessions with the fuzzer.

options.content: Host calls and accumulation, the statistics a block keeps, and the plan of a block import. One row per Part, its panels in lesson order; a panel's ⓘ says which program fills it.

panels.title: Host calls
panels.description: What bin/host.ts saw: every host call a real service made during accumulation, the answer it got in φ₇, the gas left, the transfers it sent, and how the service stopped.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="host", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{if eq .step \"sent\"}}sent {{.amount}} to service {{.dest}}, with {{.gas}} gas, memo {{.memo}}{{else if .name}}host call {{.call}} ({{.name}}): {{.said}}, {{.gas}} gas left{{else}}stops {{.exit}}{{if .used}}, using {{.used}} gas{{else}}, {{.gas}} gas left{{end}}{{end}}"

panels.title: Accumulate
panels.description: What bin/accumulate.ts did: a test vector's block accumulated, which packages went and how many reports still wait, the cores' assigners before and after, the reports each round took, the outputs and their root, then each service's digests, transfers received and gas next to the vector's.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="accumulate", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{if .slot}}slot {{.slot}}: accumulated {{.went}}; {{.waiting}} still waiting{{if .assigners}}; assigners {{.assigners}}{{end}}{{if .rounds}}; reports per round {{.rounds}}{{end}}{{if .root}}; outputs {{.outputs}}, root {{.root}}{{end}}{{else}}service {{.s}}:{{if .count}} {{.count}} digest(s),{{end}}{{if .inputs}} {{.inputs}} input(s),{{end}}{{if .transfers}} {{.transfers}} transfer(s),{{end}} used {{.used}} (vector: {{.expected}}){{end}}"

panels.title: Validator statistics
panels.description: What bin/statistics.ts did: each validator's tally (blocks, tickets, preimages, preimage bytes, guarantees, assurances) before and after one block.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="statistics", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "validator {{.i}}: {{.before}} -> {{.after}}{{if eq .epoch_turned \"true\"}} (new epoch){{end}}"

panels.title: Core and service activity
panels.description: What bin/activity.ts did: one block's tallies for each core (data load, popularity, the work it took on) and each service (its share of that work), the fields that aren't zero.

panels.title: Block import plan
panels.description: What bin/plan.ts printed: the Gray Paper's block-import steps (§4.2) in waves, each with what it's made from and the lesson that builds it. Steps in one wave don't need each other.

panels.title: Whole state
panels.description: What bin/whole-state.ts read from a real state: each component by its Gray Paper letter and size, then each service account and its entries.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="state", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{if .letter}}C({{.i}}) {{.letter}}: {{.size}} bytes{{else}}service {{.s}}: balance {{.balance}}, {{.items}} entries{{end}}"

panels.title: Block import
panels.description: What bin/import.ts did with a trace, block after block: imported or refused, and whether the state root is the trace's.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="import", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{if .n}}block {{.n}}, slot {{.slot}}: {{.what}}; root {{.root}}… {{if eq .same \"true\"}}= the trace's{{else}}≠ the trace's{{end}}{{else}}{{.family}}: {{.matched}} of 100 state roots as the trace's{{end}}"

panels.title: Target
panels.description: Each message the target got in a session, and its answer.

panels.title: Fuzz session
panels.description: What bin/fuzz.ts saw, block by block: the target's answer, and whether it is the trace's.

targets.expr: {job="gray_tutorial", client="$client", kind="fuzz", run_id=~"$run_id"} | json | line_format "{{if .n}}block {{.n}}, slot {{.slot}}: {{.said}}{{if eq .ok \"true\"}}, as the trace has it{{else}}, NOT as the trace has it{{end}}{{else}}{{.family}}: {{.agreed}} of 100 blocks as the trace has them{{end}}"
